**The Impact You'll Make

**You will shape the future of sustainable, high‑performance data centers by designing the physical system architectures that make them efficient, reliable, and scalable. Your work will directly influence how energy, cooling, and hardware come together to support the world’s most demanding digital infrastructure.

At Danfoss, data center sustainability is not a promise—it’s a mission. As a Senior Innovation Engineer, Liquid Cooling Data Center you will help customers reduce energy consumption, improve thermal performance, and prepare for next‑generation, high‑density compute environments.

You will work at the intersection of innovation and real‑world impact, collaborating across engineering, product, and customer teams to turn advanced thermal concepts into practical, deployable solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Design end‑to‑end thermal system architectures for air‑ and liquid‑cooled data centers, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Translate customer and business needs into system designs that integrate cooling components, facility loops, and rack‑level solutions.

• Define system requirements and boundary conditions to enable accurate simulation, CFD analysis, and performance modeling.

• Collaborate across engineering, product, and customer teams to support new builds and retrofit projects from concept to implementation.

• Drive innovation in liquid cooling and thermal optimization, contributing to next‑generation platforms and protected intellectual property.

**What We're Looking For

**

• At least 5 years of experience designing thermal or liquid cooling systems for data centers or similarly complex energy systems.

• Strong system‑level mindset, with the ability to connect facility infrastructure, cooling distribution, and rack‑level solutions into cohesive designs.

• Solid foundation in thermal engineering, including heat transfer, flow dynamics, and overall system optimization.

• Clear communicator, able to explain complex designs through schematics, diagrams, and well‑structured technical documentation.

• Hands‑on experience with engineering and design tools, such as CAD platforms and thermal or CFD simulation environments, and willingness to global travel up to 20% of the time.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Do you study International Shipping & Trade at Copenhagen Business School, and are you looking for an internship where you can set direction and create valuable impact? Join us to help shape the future of digital freight through innovative projects in a dynamic international company.

**Be part of the movement - and play your part

****Internship: Freight Digital Customer Journey

**In this role, you will support key initiatives within the transformation of the digital customer journey for our Global Freight Customer Service organisation at DFDS. Our ambition is clear: by 2030, we want to deliver a seamless, digital, and standardised set-up that makes it easy to be a customer and easy to interact with customers across all freight touchpoints.

To achieve this, our Customer Service transformation is built on three strategic pillars:

• Self-Service:

• Building a one-stop-shop where customers can book and track units throughout the entire journey and across transport modalities.

• Contact Center Platform:

• Creating an interaction platform that enables Customer Service teams to engage with customers efficiently when support is needed, supported by a knowledge base that enhances the overall customer experience.

• Control Tower:

• Developing our internal platform for managing customer bookings, providing Customer Service with a more seamless and standardised way of handling bookings and tracking units across the DFDS network.

As an intern, you will work across all three pillars, supporting and driving the planning, coordination, and delivery of transformation initiatives. You will gain exposure to business and technology stakeholders and help ensure that projects move forward efficiently while creating value for our Customer Service organisation and customers.

**Examples Of Responsibilities

**

• Lead and assist on projects in various areas along the customer journey to help drive digitisation and standardisation across the DFDS Ferry domain (e.g. standardising customer service and sales processes)

• Drive or assist with project planning, coordination, and follow-up on key initiatives depending on size of project

• Prepare presentations for key stakeholders at all levels of the organisation including the executive suite

• Manage stakeholders e.g. local DFDS offices, and help roll out digitalisation and standardisation initiatives by interacting with particularly local customer service teams

• Conduct end-to-end process explorations and ad-hoc analyses, incl. building business cases

• Helping track project progress, dependencies, risks, and actions across initiatives

• Support with implementations e.g. testing, plan change management activities and ensure solutions are properly adopted

You will gain hands-on experience with large-scale business transformation, digital product development, process improvement, and change management in an international organisation.

You will play an important supporting role in our Customer Service transformation by helping teams stay aligned, ensuring key activities are coordinated effectively, and contributing to the successful adoption of new digital solutions and ways of working across the organisation.

**About You

**Are you eager to deepen your knowledge in the field of digital freight, and do you have a strong work ethic and passion for learning? Then this internship is for you!

**Additionally, We Are Looking For You Who Have

**

• A positive and curious mindset, also in dynamic periods

• A desire to make an impact, share your ideas and learn from others

• You keep things on track and get the details right

• Good collaboration skills, excited to contribute to an international organisation with colleagues from diverse backgrounds

**Furthermore, You Are

**

• Studying BSc International Shipping & Trade at Copenhagen Business School, ready to intern from September 2027

• A natural problem solver, when working individually and in a team

• Detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy in your work

• Proactive in identifying and understanding data sources and solutions to data collection

• Confident using Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Power BI or similar tools is a plus

• Curious about AI and eager to use it to solve real business problems

We believe the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

**We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. Our newly built headquarters in Copenhagen is a unique, modern workplace. Here, we enjoy our own game room, fitness & massage, cantina and café, and a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

You’ll get the opportunity to join our student community, where you can participate in social and professional activities, connecting with fellow students from various departments across the organisation.

We plan to welcome three interns from BSc International Shipping & Trade in 2027, one in Global Customer Service, one in Direct Procurement and one in Procurement Technology, Sustainability & Operations. This gives you a chance to join a cohort where you can share experiences, exchange ideas, and grow together.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

**If you think your personality, skills and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

For questions about the recruitment, contact metboes@dfds.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Your impact begins here

**As Advanced data analyst in CMC Pilots, you will turn manufacturing and supply chain data into faster, better-informed decisions. You will scope, build and maintain the analytics that help colleagues get the most out of our production facilities and execute their processes better. As production demands rise to deliver Novo’s clinical pipeline, your work helps CMC Pilots act with clarity and pace, to ensure Novo have the API and Drug Product to deliver our clinical trials on time.

**What You’ll Bring

**You will bring a background in manufacturing, chemistry, business analytics, data science or a related field, and the confidence to take an idea from definition to a working tool that people use.

• A Master’s degree. The field is flexible, for example engineering, business, IT, logistics or similar.

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, production or a similar operational environment.

• Experience scoping, developing and monitoring data and analytics solutions in production.

• Hands-on skills in Power BI or another BI tool, SQL and Python.

• A high level of data literacy and the ability to explain data value and requirements to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Experience working with and understanding complex enterprise architectures.

• A user-first mindset: you involve users early, work iteratively and check that business value is realised.

• Independence, ownership and drive, with strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

• Fluent English. Danish is not a requirement.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with BI or manufacturing intelligence in API or Drug Product processes. Broader production experience is also relevant.

• Databricks and PySpark, as the team expects to use them more.

• ETL/ELT pipeline development, data modelling, orchestration (Databricks Jobs, Apache Airflow or similar), GitHub or Azure DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.

• Experience with REST APIs and JSON, cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), and basic networking, security or Microsoft Entra ID concepts.

• Experience with manufacturing, time-series, MES, LIMS, DCS/SCADA or historian data, and with working in regulated GxP environments.

**What You’ll Do

**You will help CMC Pilots use data more and better to reach its operational and strategic goals. That means:

• Identify, scope, draft, develop and maintain data and analytics products for stakeholders in CMC Pilots.

• Help colleagues see where data can address their challenges and engage them in using it.

• Work with the central IT organisation on architecture, best practice and use cases.

• Communicate with key internal and external stakeholders, making decisions and keeping work moving.

• Support data analyst student assistants in their development and deliverables.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Data & Supply Chain team in CMC Pilots Business Support, part of CMC in Global Manufacturing & Supply. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo products, scaling molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

Your team has 15 professionals with varied cultural and educational backgrounds. They work on supply chain and production planning, business analytics and improvement projects, driven by exploration, process optimisation and solving complex business challenges. You will also partner with the central IT organisation and with stakeholders across CMC Pilots, and you will guide student assistants on the team.

Your main location is Bagsværd, in the Copenhagen area.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will own your work from first idea through implementation and validation and be trusted to take initiative. The team expects to use Databricks more, so there is room to build new skills as the data setup grows. You will learn from colleagues on the job, develop through relevant learning offerings, and be recognised for results.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 DKK - 838,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to put data behind better decisions in pharmaceutical manufacturing, apply for the Advanced data analyst role by 1 December 2026. Please apply by submitting your CV including a brief motivation for applying.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Why Faculty?

**We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

**Why the Faculty Fellowship?

**Founded in 2014, Faculty is one of Europe’s leading applied AI companies. Faculty’s PhD-heavy team of deep AI experts has delivered hundreds of real-world AI products to improve critical public services and drive sustained economic returns across every sector of the economy. Widely recognised as a leader in AI safety, Faculty works for the world’s leading AI labs, such as OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic, to ensure their latest models are safe, human-led and explainable.

The Faculty Fellowship builds the AI talent engine for the world’s most ambitious organisations. It selects exceptional scientific minds and accelerates them into the top tier of AI practitioners. Past Fellows hold some of the most critical AI posts for organisations across every sector of the economy.

As part of our international expansion, we are bringing the Faculty Fellowship to Denmark through Halfspace (part of Faculty), a leading applied AI company in Copenhagen. Building on Faculty’s decade-long track record of developing exceptional AI talent and Halfspace’s expertise in delivering real-world AI solutions, the Fellowship will offer outstanding STEM talent in Denmark an opportunity to accelerate their careers in AI. As a Fellow, you will learn directly from leading AI practitioners before being embedded within an ambitious organisation, applying advanced AI and data science to solve complex commercial challenges and deliver meaningful impact.

**How It Works

**

• 2 Weeks of Intensive Training: Learn to apply your advanced technical knowledge to real-world data science problems.

• 6 Week Paid Placement: Tackle a commercial data science project with a host company.

• Demo Day Finale: Present your work to senior stakeholders and industry leaders, showcasing your technical capabilities and project impact.

Where our alumni go: our alumni have gone on to shape the future at companies like Google, Meta, Tesco and AstraZeneca, as well as disruptive startups like Physics X and Orbital Witness. We are also incredibly proud that a high percentage of fellows choose to continue their journey internally, joining the Faculty team permanently.

**About The Role

**As a Fellow at Faculty, you will join an elite cohort transforming industries through cutting-edge data science. This intensive, eight week programme bridges academic and real world impact, embedding you directly into highs-stakes commercial environments. You will apply advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex, ambiguous problems for our clients, turning theoretical knowledge into high-value deployable solutions. It is a fast-paced launchpad designed to accelerate your technical growth, build exceptional commercial acumen and employer you to shape the future of artificial intelligence in an ambitious, forward-thinking tech community.

**Who We're Looking For

**

• You hold a finished PhD or Master’s degree in a STEM subject, complemented by a strong foundation in data science or machine learning.

• You possess a high level of mathematical competence alongside solid experience with theoretical concepts like hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and neural networks.

• You demonstrate strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and feel comfortable navigating core data science coding libraries.

• You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, showing the resilience and autonomy needed to structure your own project plans and hit critical deadlines.

• You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly, adapting your language seamlessly for both technical peers and non-technical partners.

• You thrive in fast-paced, ambitious environments, showing curiosity and a relentless drive to learn and deploy new technologies.

**Requirements

**

• Right to work: We’re unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, so you’ll need to already have the right to work in Denmark. This includes citizens of EU/EEA countries and Switzerland, as well as anyone holding a valid Danish work permit or residence status. If your eligibility is based on a visa or permit, please include the details in your application so we can review your situation.

• Location & Logistics: This is a fully in-person, eight-week programme based in Copenhagen, Denmark so you will need to be able to commute daily for the entire duration. Please keep in mind that Faculty is unable to provide or reimburse accommodation and travel expenses.

**Our Timelines

**

• December 2026: Coding tests sent via email.

• January 2026: Interviewing starts - held remotely online.

• February 2027: Final notifications sent to all applicants.

• March 2027*: Programme starts.

• Please note that programme dates are tentative and may be adjusted if required. We will notify all applicants of any updates and changes as early as possible.

What the Fellowship offers

• Paid Experience: Fellows receive a competitive stipend/salary for the full eight-week duration of the programme.

• Expert-Led Training: Two weeks of immersive lectures followed by weekly Friday masterclasses, bridging the gap between academic theory and commercial data science.Dedicated Mentorship: Receive ongoing support and guidance from experienced Faculty practitioners, gaining insight into how AI and data science are applied to solve real-world business challenges while developing your technical, commercial and communication skills.

• Real-World Value: A dedicated six-week placement embedded with a business, tackling a high-stakes data science challenge.

• Career Launchpad: A proven pathway into industry, backed by a decade-long track record of launching exceptional individuals into top-tier AI careers.

• Unrivalled Networking: Connect with a 500+ strong alumni community and pitch your project to 100+ industry guests at Demo Day.

**Our Recruitment Ethos

**We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

_Are you ready to spark transformation and make an impact at a leading global brand? Look no further!

_As part of our Digital and Technology organisation, we are looking for a Programme Manager to lead the rollout projects of our SAP S/4HANA solution across our core value chain. You will join our Delivery Excellence department, working closely with Delivery Leads, Project Managers, Programme Managers, and other delivery roles.

Our global SAP S/4HANA business transformation programme has established the foundation, template and delivery experience required to transform and standardize core business processes across Pandora. Having successfully progressed through the initial rollout waves, we are now entering the next phase: scaling deployment across markets and business units globally. Our ambition is to make each subsequent rollout faster, more efficient and increasingly repeatable, leveraging a mature global template, standardized delivery approach and lessons learned from previous deployments. This position will be instrumental in driving this evolution, taking ownership of end-to-end rollout delivery while helping build a scalable, high-performing rollout capability that combines speed and efficiency with strong business outcomes, adoption and delivery quality.

We would like to hear from you if you are passionate about orchestrating complex deliveries, a strong delivery leader who can guide and influence teams, and an enabler who fosters alignment and collaboration. You bring a structured yet empowering approach, grounded in a servant-leadership mindset. You have solid experience in programme management and have previously worked in roles such as Programme Manager, Project Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar, ideally within an SAP ECC or S/4HANA transformation. You do not need to be the SAP solution expert, but you understand what it takes to lead one, and you know the right questions to ask and when to challenge. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with diverse stakeholders, where your communication, coordination, and relationship-building skills are essential to driving successful outcomes.

**In Your Role As Programme Manager You Will

**

• Lead end-to-end delivery of SAP S/4HANA rollouts, from mobilization and design through build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timeline, budget and quality while protecting business continuity.

• Drive rollout scale, speed and efficiency, applying standardized ways of working, lessons learned and continuous improvement to make successive deployments increasingly predictable, repeatable and efficient.

• Mobilize and lead cross-functional rollout teams, securing the right business and technology resources, establishing clear accountabilities, governance and ways of working, and creating strong collaboration across global and local teams.

• Own the integrated rollout plan and critical path, actively managing dependencies, resource constraints, risks, issues and competing initiatives, identifying potential bottlenecks early and driving timely resolution.

• Partner closely with business leaders and functional teams to ensure business requirements are understood, the global template is adopted effectively, and the organization is ready for the change.

• Provide strong delivery governance and executive transparency, establishing relevant performance metrics, facilitating Steering Committees, enabling timely decision-making and escalating material risks or issues when required.

• Orchestrate execution across design, build and testing, ensuring scope and design decisions are aligned with template standards, build activities progress to plan, and integration and user acceptance testing provide confidence in business and solution readiness.

• Lead cutover and go-live readiness, coordinating business cutover, data migration, dress rehearsals, readiness assessments, contingency planning and go/no-go decision-making to enable a controlled and successful launch.

• Lead the transition into hypercare and steady-state operations, ensuring system stability, rapid resolution of critical issues, effective knowledge transfer and clear criteria for hypercare exit.

• Manage the performance of system integration and delivery partners, setting clear expectations, monitoring delivery against commitments and proactively addressing or escalating performance challenges.

• Champion continuous improvement across the rollout portfolio, translating experience and lessons learned into simpler processes, stronger delivery practices and opportunities to accelerate future rollouts.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• Demonstrated experience leading complex programmes or large-scale transformations in a global organisation.

• Practical SAP S/4HANA programme experience, in a leadership role, covering stages from design and build through testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare

• Experience working with vendor-led delivery and SAP implementation partners.

• Strong coordination, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to turn complexity into concise, actionable messages.

• Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and driving challenging discussions and decisions.

• Comfortable working in matrixed, multi-team and international environments.

• A delivery mindset, taking ownership for outcomes and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Service Desk Technician - Network

**Would you like to work hands-on with B2B network operations and help keep critical digital infrastructure running? In this role, you will take ownership of customer cases, troubleshoot network-related issues and make sure the right actions are taken when services are affected.

**What You Need To Succeed

**

• Relevant education in IT/ networking.

• Experience working with network products and a good understanding of network structures.

• Professional communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Experience working in a structured way with operational cases, where you prioritise according to SLAs and business criticality.

**About The Role And The Team

**You will join a specialised team supporting GlobalConnect’s B2B customers within network and security services. Based primarily at our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with colleagues to solve incidents, share knowledge and ensure effective handovers.

The role combines technical troubleshooting with customer communication. You will be responsible for keeping cases moving from the first contact through follow-up, resolution or the correct handover.

The role follows a planned 24/7 shift rotation with a mix of daytime, evening and night shift****s, including evening shifts around 15–23 and night shifts around 23–07. Weekend shifts are also part of the rotation.

The schedule is planned in advance and includes longer periods of consecutive days off, including full weeks off at certain points in the rotation. This gives you a combination of varied working hours and longer stretches of time away from work.

**What You’ll Be Working On

**

• Receive and handle B2B customer enquiries by phone and through our systems.

• Take ownership of cases and prioritise them according to severity, SLAs, escalations and business criticality.

• Troubleshoot and work proactively with incidents and alarms related to network and security products.

• Follow up with customers and suppliers in accordance with agreed SLAs.

• Ensure clear handovers between shifts, colleagues and departments.

• Contribute to quality assurance of customer solutions and participate in customer meetings when needed.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and take responsibility for moving your cases forward. You can maintain an overview when priorities change or a customer situation becomes critical, and you communicate technical information clearly to people with different levels of technical knowledge.

Experience from telecommunications or IT would be useful, as would knowledge of SD-WAN, Layer 2 and Layer 3. Experience with Cisco, Juniper or similar network equipment, ServiceNow, ITIL or network certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA or ACMA would also be an advantage.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

**Our recruitment process

**

• Talent Acquisition Screening Interview

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• References

• Final alignment meeting

**Practical information

**

• Location: Copenhagen.

• The role is primarily office-based.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

You will get the opportunity to work with B2B network and security services, take ownership of operational customer cases and collaborate closely with colleagues in a specialised team.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

**About Us

**GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Gubra is a science-enabled biotech company advancing peptide-based drug discovery, development and preclinical research, driven by impact for patients, planet and people. If you are a pragmatic, collaborative lawyer who wants to use your legal expertise to help us succeed in a fast-paced fun environment, you will thrive with us.

The opportunity

As Gubra continues to grow, so does the breadth and complexity of the legal and compliance matters supporting our business. We are therefore looking for a Legal Counsel to join our Legal team and work across Gubra's CRO Services, Biotech, Ventures and group functions.

Gubra operates at the intersection of scientific research, drug discovery and development, and commercial partnerships. Our activities span Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, Gubra Green, CRO Services, enabled by specialist corporate functions, in an entrepreneurial environment of around 330 employees.

Reporting to the Group General Counsel, you will have a broad role spanning commercial contracting, healthcare compliance, corporate governance and general legal advice. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, translating legal requirements into pragmatic solutions that enable the business to move forward while managing risk appropriately.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a growing life sciences business operates.

Your role

You will act as a trusted legal partner to the business, with a particular focus on supporting Gubra's CRO Services,  and Biotech discovery and development activities.

A significant part of the role will involve contracts. You will help simplify and strengthen the way we contract, including taking a leading role in templates, reviews and legal contracting support for CRO Services. You will also draft, review and negotiate agreements across Biotech and our group functions.

Beyond contracting, you will advise colleagues on a broad range of legal and compliance matters across the product lifecycle and help our functions build legal and compliance by design into their processes from the outset.

You will work across professional disciplines and therefore need to understand both the legal or compliance issue at hand and the commercial, scientific or operational context around it.

How you will create impact

• Lead legal drafting, review and negotiation as primary contracting support for our CRO Services business, including the development and maintenance of practical contract templates, playbooks and review processes and related legal technology opportunities.

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including vendor, clinical trial, CRO/CDMO, IT, intercompany, confidentiality and consultancy agreements.

• Advise on legal and healthcare compliance matters across the biotech discovery and development lifecycle, including anti-bribery and corruption, advertising and promotion, development and regulatory matters, privacy and data protection, exclusivity and product liability.

• Partner with group functions to support the group leads to embed compliance into their activities and ways of working, including matters related to websites and digital channels, AI, cyber and information security, data protection, labour and employment, health and safety, equity incentive programms, tax and immigration, property, environment and other ESG requirements.

• Support public-company corporate governance and affiliate management, including corporate filings, Board and affiliate activities, whistleblower arrangements, disclosure requirements and insider-trading processes.

• Help develop, implement and continuously improve legal and compliance policies, communications and training programmes.

• Support the implementation and effective use of legal and compliance technology, with a focus on simplifying processes, improving visibility and increasing efficiency.

• Monitor relevant changes in laws and regulations, assess their potential impact on Gubra and help translate new requirements into practical actions across the business.

• Work closely with colleagues across the Gubra functions on matters requiring cross-functional legal input.

Your profile

We are looking for a collaborative and commercially minded risk focused lawyer who combines strong legal fundamentals with curiosity, sound judgement and a pragmatic approach to help the business act responsibly. You are comfortable working independently, and equally comfortable involving colleagues or escalating issues when the circumstances call for it.

We expect that you bring:

• Approximately 3–5 years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2 years of in-house experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device or biotech industry.

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts across all business areas, including agreements relevant to pharmaceutical development, biotech or CRO activities.

• A passion for helping build solutions to the business deliver in the right way and balanced risk tolerance and assessment.

• A good understanding of the legal and compliance environment applicable to life sciences companies and an ability to apply that knowledge pragmatically.

• Experience advising internal stakeholders and translating complex legal requirements into clear and actionable guidance.

• The ability to manage and deliver competing priorities, a varied workload in a fast paced environment and move comfortably between detailed contract work and broader legal, compliance and governance questions.

• A university degree in Law. Admission to the bar or equivalent qualification to practise law is an advantage.

• Ability to draft in English and Danish. Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

It is an advantage if you also bring:

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

Who you are

Do you love to get up before everybody else and drive a forklift truck? If so, you are a good match as a forklift driver for our goods receiving department. When IKEA opens at 10 AM, it is important we have emptied the trucks, received goods, and replenished the shelves so we are ready for our customers. In this job it is a requirement that you have a license for operating forklift trucks and experience with driving both reach trucks and powered stacker.

In addition we expect that you:

• Are in good physical shape and can handle hard manual labor

• Thrive by working during the night and early hours of the day

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• Have a danish forklift license - or are willing to acquire it

• Are detail-oriented and comfortable working with software and digital tools

A day in your life with us

As a forklift driver you play an important part for IKEA’s customers and sales, because you and your team make sure our home furnishing solutions and accessories are always accessible for our customers. Every day is fast paced because we work with a sharp deadline at 10 AM, when the store opens.

Your tasks will be:

• Receiving and handling goods by unloading trucks and loading goods into the warehouse by driving reach truck and powered stacker

• Working together and following up with colleagues to keep the store fully stocked

• Handling of goods and stock taking, as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Proactively securing the safety of your colleagues and our customers in your working area

• Maintenance of machinery and cleaning up the department.

Together as a team

Here you will become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently you gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are. We will ensure the correct training, so you will feel safe and competent in the job. At IKEA you have endless possibilities to grow.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact our Logistics Team Leader, Chrysostomos Milas (chrysostomos.milas@ingka.ikea.com). Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Other information

• This position is for an average of 32 hours pr. week

• Your working time will vary based on the business need, with shifts primarily in the night and early morning hours from 02:30-10:00. You should also expect to work every second weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input for the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, kantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience - whether you are young, senior, or somewhere in between. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

**

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!
